Ichijou"What do we do!? Contact Mr. Minato and—"
Sayo"...No. This Sayo shall go. Miss Ayane, may I leave matters here in your hands?"
Ichijou"...Huh? Aap jaake karogi kya—what are YOU going to do there!?"

Ichijou"Arre, arre, arre... Just wait a—"
Sayo"Then, if you will excuse me."
